notes: NEW identity-only gap. Midnight item 281238 Aberrant Commander's Gauntlets is epic mail armor, base catalog ilvl219; a current Blizzard armory page shows the same named item equipped at ilvl334, but readable page does not provide the exact worn itemLink, bonusID, DE eligibility or Disenchant attempt. Source separately lists 279/292/305/318 raid level by difficulty and Great Vault maximum 334; none is a cast-time ilvl observation. Item 281236 Chestwrap of Palpable Terror is epic leather chest, also base ilvl219 (source link). Existing 281056/281235 Kith'ix catalog-only noDisenchant flags already documented in earlier evidence and not re-imported. Wowhead boss 'Drop Chance' percentages are boss gear loot rates, NOT material processing probabilities. Searches across Wowhead, Method, Blizzard armory, GamGem, NeedBeforeGreed and guildloot found no independent current-live cast log or per-material hits, zeros, stacks, output IDs, or skill/specialization. This record is not a measured cohort or item-level eligibility proof.
